description: HTML source code for a web-based database viewer interface, including styling, layout, and client-side JavaScript for fetching and displaying database information and table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by reloading databases and resetting UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles display of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and inserts an HTML table for given data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates a table cell, handling JSON objects and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or objects.
